title: Unit 3
text: Hi, Mrs Mouse! Thanks for doing the shopping for me every week.
Why are you so happy, Bobby?
Because I have a good idea for my homework!
Mum, look at this! You're my hero. Now I know everyone can be great.
Why did Bobby want to write about his mother?
